parameters.name: BlockAction
parameters.description:
The action taken upon a rule hit. Exact match is used. Valid values:

- Audit: Audit.
- Observe: Observe only.
- WhiteList: Allowed by whitelist.
- Block: Blocked.
- Redirect: Redirected to a prompt page.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The department. Exact match is used.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The policy type used to filter results.

parameters.name: RemoteHost
parameters.description: The destination domain name accessed. Exact match is used.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The username. Exact match is used.
